prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a companion template or customize appearance with live visual preview.", "Select Pet"]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Quick tips for managing your desktop pet background status and interactions.", "Press Alt+P anytime to summon or hide pet", "Right-click pet on desktop for settings & chat", "Got It!"]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Companion...", "Verifying screen overlay permissions and rendering companion frame."]
4: ["Sign in to permanently sync your pet memories and settings to your account.", "Note: Use the same account method to avoid creating duplicate empty profiles."]
5: ["Did you know? Desktop pets earn happiness while you work!", "Estimated generation time: 2 min"]
6: ["How Would You Like to Get Your Companion?", "Select Quick Adopt vs Custom Creation"]
7: ["Upload well-lit, single-subject front photos for best pet generation fidelity.", "Tip: Avoid blurry or dimly lit photos to ensure pet features match."]
8: ["Feel free to minimize! We'll notify you when your pet is ready on your desktop."]
9: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Double-click anytime to bring up controls.", "Official Companion Adopted", "Meet Your Companion"]
